baseline_cases.reason: Original main test remains an expected passing behavior; any failure is retained and fails this comparison gate.
Original main test remains an expected passing behavior; timeout or another failure fails this comparison gate.

limits: Observational comparison on the exact b1 main Rust, test, Cargo and lockfile inputs; only an uncompiled README comment differs between phase copies.
All tests in the main library, mock_produce and producer_retained_backing binaries run for both profiles on one thread with an 8 MiB stack. Ignored test identities are retained.
The 15 mock test identities and retained-backing identity correspond to v8 failures, but main fixture and production behavior can differ. No cause is assumed.
Failures, unexpected passes, timeouts and ignored cases are retained. A failure fails the gate; this comparison does not establish release readiness or fastest performance.
Other integration binaries, standard-stack live Kafka, sustained campaigns and external record histories remain separate qualifications.
